title: Wt 6.10 – Present Perfect PL → EN
intro: Mikro-zadanie z planu tygodnia: pięć zdań, w których polski czas teraźniejszy to po angielsku Present Perfect.

items.label: Tłumaczenie PL → EN
items.instruction: Przetłumacz na angielski, bez podglądania kart.
items.source: Przez lata coraz bardziej angażuję się w chór.
answers: Over the years, I've got more and more involved in the choir.
Over the years, I've become more and more involved in the choir.
Over the years, I've been getting more and more involved in the choir.
Over the years, I've gotten more and more involved in the choir.
items.explain: Over the years + Present Perfect, bo zmiana trwa do teraz. Nie *through the years* i nie Present Simple (Twój błąd z 29.09).

items.label: Tłumaczenie PL → EN
items.instruction: Przetłumacz na angielski, bez podglądania kart.
items.source: Uczę się angielskiego od trzech lat.
answers: I've been learning English for three years.
I've been studying English for three years.
items.explain: for + okres → Present Perfect Continuous. Nie *I learn English since three years*.

items.label: Tłumaczenie PL → EN
items.instruction: Przetłumacz na angielski, bez podglądania kart.
items.source: Mieszkam w tym mieście od 2019 roku.
answers: I've lived in this city since 2019.
I've been living in this city since 2019.
I've lived in this town since 2019.
I've been living in this town since 2019.
items.explain: since + punkt w czasie → Present Perfect. Live brzmi dobrze w Simple i w Continuous.

items.label: Tłumaczenie PL → EN
items.instruction: Przetłumacz na angielski, bez podglądania kart.
items.source: Wiele się zmieniło, odkąd pracuję w tej firmie.
answers: A lot has changed since I started working for this company.
A lot has changed since I started working at this company.
A lot has changed since I joined this company.
Much has changed since I joined this company.
A lot has changed since I started working here.
items.explain: W zdaniu głównym Present Perfect (has changed), po since Past Simple (since I started / joined). Nie *since I work here*.

items.label: Tłumaczenie PL → EN
items.instruction: Przetłumacz na angielski, bez podglądania kart.
answers: How long have you known your teacher?
How long have you known your tutor?
items.explain: How long + Present Perfect. Nie *How long do you know…*; know nie ma formy Continuous.
